description: Canonical ARK Milestone 4 world command protocol. Single source of truth shared by the TypeScript simulator and the Python mission-control backend. All units SI unless noted.

get_world_state.description: Read the current planet, simulation time, environment state, and test-body telemetry. Read-only.

list_capabilities.description: List registered world capabilities (built-in and approved synthesized) with schemas.

switch_planet.description: Switch the active world between Earth and Mars. Resets environment and respawns test bodies.

set_gravity.description: Set gravitational acceleration magnitude. Values far from the planetary default are labeled experimental overrides, not realistic physics.

set_wind.description: Set manual wind by speed and meteorological compass direction (degrees clockwise from north, direction FROM which wind blows).

set_temperature.description: Set ambient temperature. Display/state only in Milestone 4; no rigid-body coupling claimed.

set_surface_traction.description: Set the manual surface traction multiplier applied on top of wetness effects.

start_weather_event.description: Start a scheduled weather event (rain, wind gust, dust storm, temperature shift, cloud). Rain/cloud are Earth-only; dust storms are Mars-only.

stop_weather_event.description: Cancel a running weather event by id.

set_solar_illumination.description: Set a manual solar multiplier (experimental shade) composed with cloud/dust attenuation. 1 = unmodified.

regenerate_terrain.description: Regenerate terrain from a seed. Omitting the seed picks a fresh random one. Same seed reproduces the same terrain.

pause_simulation.description: Pause physics stepping and event progression. Rendering continues.

resume_simulation.description: Resume physics stepping and event progression.

reset_environment.description: Clear all events and restore planet base conditions. Overwrites active schedules.

apply_scenario.description: Apply a predefined scenario preset (manual settings plus scheduled events). Switches planet first if the scenario belongs to the other world.

assign_rover_mission.description: Deploy an available rover from robot home and assign a PPO navigation, habitat construction, or sample collection mission at a target coordinate.

assign_drone_mission.description: Deploy an available scout drone from robot home and assign a PPO aerial scouting mission at a target coordinate.

eventTargets.description: Target channels for start_weather_event. At least one required; all optional individually.
